measurement: Unchanged AIRI queries and gold ids; default production SQL, threshold, ranking and query normalization. Twenty approved fixture documents per language. Only zh-to-en uses the English corpus. Gold labels never enter embedding input or retrieval.
failurePolicy: Stop on the first transport, admission, storage or protocol failure; no retry. Individual relevance misses are measurements, and the frozen aggregate thresholds decide acceptance after all 90 cases. Self-test is wiring evidence only.
